purpose: Review inventory only; not a creation payload or published feature declaration

schema.description: Master seed and optional per-subsystem re-rolls.

master.description: Master seed. Any text or integer; same seed + config + generator version reproduces the same town byte for byte.
master.title: Master

town.description: Override seed for geography only (roads growth, parcels, buildings).
town.title: Town

households.description: Override seed for household attributes (occupants, solar, EV, heating).
households.title: Households

weather.description: Override seed for weather series (re-roll storms, keep the town).
weather.title: Weather

anomalies.description: Override seed for the meter-to-cash run (missed reads, anomalies, analyst work, bill checks); a request's run seed overrides it per run.
anomalies.title: Anomalies

schema.title: Seeds

schema.description: Size, street grid, terrain and land use. Towns are generic: every street comes from these settings and the seed.

houses.description: Number of residential premises to place.
houses.title: Houses

units.description: Display unit profile (stored values are always SI).
units.title: Units

street_pattern.description: Original street pattern or connected neighborhood loops and shorter blocks. New towns only.
street_pattern.title: Street Pattern

anchor_lat.description: Latitude of the town (sun path, day length).
anchor_lat.title: Anchor Lat

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the town (read schedules, billing calendar, day/night).
timezone.title: Timezone

arterial_spacing_m.description: Mean spacing of arterial roads (concession-grid style).
arterial_spacing_m.title: Arterial Spacing M

arterial_warp_m.description: Amplitude of the smooth warp applied to arterials.
arterial_warp_m.title: Arterial Warp M

collector_block_m.description: Superblocks larger than this get a collector road.
collector_block_m.title: Collector Block M

era_core_year.description: Construction year at the town centre.
era_core_year.title: Era Core Year

era_span_years.description: Years added from centre to edge (era = core + span·(d/R)^1.2 + noise).
era_span_years.title: Era Span Years

era_noise_years.description: Std-dev of era noise per district.
era_noise_years.title: Era Noise Years

park_share.description: Share of blocks kept as parks.
park_share.title: Park Share

commercial_strip_m.description: Length of the downtown main street: arterial frontage within half this distance of the centre is all commercial (up to 80 lots). The frontage shares below apply beyond it.
commercial_strip_m.title: Commercial Strip M

commercial_share_arterial.description: Share of developed lots fronting an arterial (beyond the downtown main street) that become commercial or mixed-use premises. The rest are homes, or rear yards where modern subdivisions back onto the arterial.
commercial_share_arterial.title: Commercial Share Arterial

commercial_share_collector.description: Share of developed lots fronting a collector that become commercial or mixed-use premises.
commercial_share_collector.title: Commercial Share Collector

commercial_share_local.description: Share of developed lots on local streets that become commercial (corner stores near downtown and where local streets meet main roads).
commercial_share_local.title: Commercial Share Local

commercial_cluster_m.description: Distance over which commercial frontage clusters around main-road intersections and downtown. Smaller gives tight corner clusters, larger gives long strips.
commercial_cluster_m.title: Commercial Cluster M
x-effects: where storefronts sit along main roads

houses_per_school.description: One school per this many houses.
houses_per_school.title: Houses Per School

margin_m.description: Empty margin around the developed area.
margin_m.title: Margin M

corridor_max_deflection_deg.description: Arterial/collector road edges continue one corridor through a junction when the heading changes by at most this much.
corridor_max_deflection_deg.title: Corridor Max Deflection Deg

corridor_name_bonus_deg.description: Extra deflection allowed when both edges carry the same street name (a name is weak evidence of continuity).
corridor_name_bonus_deg.title: Corridor Name Bonus Deg

schema.title: Town & geography

EraValues.description: A value per construction era: pre-1945 core, 1945–1978 post-war, post-1978 modern subdivisions.
EraValues.title: EraValues

schema.description: Lots, buildings and the people and appliances inside them.

two_storey_share.description: Share of two-storey houses by era.

occupancy_rate.description: Share of premises occupied at simulation start.
occupancy_rate.title: Occupancy Rate

rental_share.description: Share of premises that are rentals (more contract turnover).
rental_share.title: Rental Share

household_size_weights.description: Relative frequency of households with 1..6 occupants.
household_size_weights.title: Household Size Weights

solar_rate.description: Share of houses with rooftop PV by era.

ev_rate.description: Share of houses with an EV charger.

electric_heat_rate.description: Share of houses heated electrically (baseboard or heat pump) where gas is available. All houses in all-electric districts are electric.

heat_pump_share_of_electric.description: Share of electric heating that is a heat pump (vs baseboard).
heat_pump_share_of_electric.title: Heat Pump Share Of Electric

ac_rate.description: Share of houses with central air conditioning.
ac_rate.title: Ac Rate

pool_rate.description: Share of houses (on lots > 600 m²) with a pool.
pool_rate.title: Pool Rate

irrigation_rate.description: Share of houses that irrigate lawns in summer.
irrigation_rate.title: Irrigation Rate

schema.title: Housing & households

schema.description: Bulk supply, substations, feeders, transformers, services.

primary_kv.description: Primary distribution line-to-line voltage (Ontario urban 13.8 kV; US 12.47 kV).
primary_kv.title: Primary Kv

kva_per_100m2.description: Individual peak demand per 100 m² of floor area (lighting, plug, appliances).
kva_per_100m2.title: Kva Per 100M2

kva_ac.description: Added peak for central air conditioning.
kva_ac.title: Kva Ac

kva_electric_heat.description: Added peak for electric resistance heat.
kva_electric_heat.title: Kva Electric Heat

kva_heat_pump.description: Added peak for a heat pump.
kva_heat_pump.title: Kva Heat Pump

kva_ev.description: Added peak for a Level-2 EV charger.
kva_ev.title: Kva Ev

kva_pool.description: Added peak for a pool pump/heater.
kva_pool.title: Kva Pool

coincidence_floor.description: Coincidence factor CF(n) = a + (1-a)/√n; a is the floor as n → ∞.
coincidence_floor.title: Coincidence Floor

transformer_max_loading.description: Allowed peak loading relative to nameplate.
transformer_max_loading.title: Transformer Max Loading

conductor_planning_margin.description: Primary conductors are sized for design load × this margin (winter peaks, load growth).
conductor_planning_margin.title: Conductor Planning Margin

max_houses_per_transformer_overhead.description: Max houses on a pole-mount transformer.
max_houses_per_transformer_overhead.title: Max Houses Per Transformer Overhead

max_houses_per_transformer_underground.description: Max houses on a pad-mount transformer.
max_houses_per_transformer_underground.title: Max Houses Per Transformer Underground

feeder_max_customers.description: Most customers planned on one feeder (limits how many lose supply when a feeder breaker trips).
feeder_max_customers.title: Feeder Max Customers

min_feeders_per_substation.description: Feeders leaving each substation at least (fewer only when it serves fewer transformer groups), so normally-open ties can back-feed.
min_feeders_per_substation.title: Min Feeders Per Substation

route_weight_arterial.description: Feeder routing cost per metre along an arterial (trunks follow the cheapest corridors).
route_weight_arterial.title: Route Weight Arterial

route_weight_collector.description: Feeder routing cost per metre along a collector.
route_weight_collector.title: Route Weight Collector

route_weight_local.description: Feeder routing cost per metre along a local street.
route_weight_local.title: Route Weight Local

route_turn_penalty_m.description: Routing cost of a 90° turn, in weighted metres; it grows with the square of the angle (a U-turn costs 4×). Bends under 10° are free.
route_turn_penalty_m.title: Route Turn Penalty M

route_corridor_change_penalty_m.description: Routing cost of switching from one arterial/collector corridor to another.
route_corridor_change_penalty_m.title: Route Corridor Change Penalty M

route_hierarchy_penalty_m.description: Routing cost per step up or down the road hierarchy (arterial ↔ collector ↔ local).
route_hierarchy_penalty_m.title: Route Hierarchy Penalty M

trunk_min_load_share.description: A feeder trunk extends along a corridor while at least this share of the feeder's connected load lies at or beyond that point; smaller tails are served by laterals.
trunk_min_load_share.title: Trunk Min Load Share

route_shared_trunk_factor.description: Cost multiplier for running a feeder express through another feeder's territory or alongside its trunk.
route_shared_trunk_factor.title: Route Shared Trunk Factor

ties_per_feeder_pair.description: Normally-open tie switches between each pair of neighbouring feeders (0: no ties at all, section ties included).
ties_per_feeder_pair.title: Ties Per Feeder Pair

tie_max_length_m.description: Longest new line built for a tie: to a feeder that touches no other feeder, or from a switched section to another feeder's three-phase line (or round to its own feeder's). Along a street a line already uses, a metre counts 1.25 (single-phase) or 2 (three-phase).
tie_max_length_m.title: Tie Max Length M

section_max_share.description: Sectionalising switches cut each feeder's three-phase backbone into sections of at most this share of the feeder's customers (at least section_min_customers), so a crew isolates a fault within a bounded section and ties back-feed the healthy sections beyond it.
section_max_share.title: Section Max Share

section_min_customers.description: Smallest section limit: a feeder is not cut into sections smaller than this many customers.
section_min_customers.title: Section Min Customers

overhead_before_year.description: Districts built before this year are overhead (poles); later underground.
overhead_before_year.title: Overhead Before Year

voltage_min_pu.description: Lower service voltage limit (CSA CAN3-C235 / ANSI Range A). Frames report it on a 120 V base (premises.voltageLimits) with the premises below it; less 4 V it is the default floor for back-feeding through a tie.
voltage_min_pu.title: Voltage Min Pu

voltage_max_pu.description: Upper service voltage limit (premises.voltageLimits in frames).
voltage_max_pu.title: Voltage Max Pu

schema.title: Electric distribution

schema.description: City gate, mains, regulators and services.

all_electric_district_share.description: Share of districts with no gas mains (all-electric).
all_electric_district_share.title: All Electric District Share

scheme.description: Medium-pressure PE everywhere with a regulator at every meter, optionally with a legacy low-pressure core fed by district regulators.
scheme.title: Scheme

transmission_kpa.description: Off-map transmission pressure at the city gate inlet.
transmission_kpa.title: Transmission Kpa

lp_kpa.description: Low-pressure legacy main set point (7 in w.c.).
lp_kpa.title: Lp Kpa

lp_core_before_year.description: Districts built before this year are on the low-pressure system.
lp_core_before_year.title: Lp Core Before Year

design_m3h_base.description: Design-hour demand per house, base component (≈ 40 CFH).
design_m3h_base.title: Design M3H Base

design_m3h_per_m2.description: Design-hour demand per m² of floor area (≈ 0.6 CFH/m²).
design_m3h_per_m2.title: Design M3H Per M2

coincidence_floor.description: Gas coincidence factor floor a in CF(n) = a + (1-a)/√n.
coincidence_floor.title: Coincidence Floor

valve_spacing_m.description: Maximum spacing of main valves on feeders.
valve_spacing_m.title: Valve Spacing M

calorific_mj_per_m3.description: Higher heating value used for energy conversion (therm/kWh display and billing).
calorific_mj_per_m3.title: Calorific Mj Per M3

base_pressure_kpa.description: Base pressure for standard volume: the Weymouth base pressure in gas main sizing and pressures (default 14.73 psia).
base_pressure_kpa.title: Base Pressure Kpa

base_temperature_c.description: Base temperature for standard volume: the Weymouth base temperature (default 520 °R, about 60 °F).
base_temperature_c.title: Base Temperature C

schema.title: Natural gas

schema.description: Supply, pumping, storage, mains, hydrants and services.

lpcd.description: Indoor residential use per person per day.
lpcd.title: Lpcd

min_main_mm.description: Smallest main where hydrants are attached.
min_main_mm.title: Min Main Mm

arterial_main_mm.description: Minimum transmission main on arterials leaving the pump station.
arterial_main_mm.title: Arterial Main Mm

hw_c_new.description: Hazen-Williams C for PVC/ductile iron mains.
hw_c_new.title: Hw C New

hw_c_old.description: Hazen-Williams C for unlined cast iron mains.
hw_c_old.title: Hw C Old

cast_iron_before_year.description: Mains along streets built before this year are unlined cast iron (the concrete trunk excepted).
cast_iron_before_year.title: Cast Iron Before Year

tank_overflow_above_ground_m.description: Elevated tank overflow height above the highest service in its zone.
tank_overflow_above_ground_m.title: Tank Overflow Above Ground M

pump_units.description: Pumps at the booster station (one is standby).
pump_units.title: Pump Units

schema.description: Meter technology mix, AMI collectors and nightly collection.

ami_route_share.description: Share of meter reading routes converted to AMI.
ami_route_share.title: Ami Route Share

amr_route_share.description: Share of routes read by drive-by AMR vans (rest are walked manually).
amr_route_share.title: Amr Route Share

poll_start_hour.description: Nightly head-end poll window start (local time).
poll_start_hour.title: Poll Start Hour

meter_digits_electric.description: Register digits on electric meters (rollover at 10^digits).
meter_digits_electric.title: Meter Digits Electric

schema.description: Seeded daily weather. Drives magnitudes and volumes, never process structure.

persistence.description: Day-to-day AR(1) persistence of temperature anomalies.
persistence.title: Persistence

schema.description: What goes wrong, how often. Rates are per year. Each operations day draws its background incidents at these rates; they are the defaults of the operations run's random-incident settings (x-run-setting), so a run can change them without a new town.

gas_service_leaks_per_1000.description: Leaks per 1,000 gas services per year.
gas_service_leaks_per_1000.title: Gas Service Leaks Per 1000

gas_main_leaks_per_100km.description: Leaks per 100 km of gas main per year.
gas_main_leaks_per_100km.title: Gas Main Leaks Per 100Km

water_main_breaks_per_100km.description: Main breaks per 100 km per year (×2 for cast iron).
water_main_breaks_per_100km.title: Water Main Breaks Per 100Km

overhead_faults_per_km_storm_day.description: Overhead primary faults per km per storm day.
overhead_faults_per_km_storm_day.title: Overhead Faults Per Km Storm Day

transformer_failures_per_1000.description: Transformer failures per 1,000 units per year (×3 when overloaded).
transformer_failures_per_1000.title: Transformer Failures Per 1000

manual_only.description: Disable random hazards; only manually injected incidents occur (the run's "Random incidents" switch defaults to the opposite).
manual_only.title: Manual Only

shift_start_hour.description: Day shift start. Non-emergency work (AMI collector repairs) waits for the day shift; emergencies are worked around the clock.
shift_start_hour.title: Shift Start Hour

gas_response_target_min.description: Target response to a gas odour call.
gas_response_target_min.title: Gas Response Target Min

schema.description: Accounts, reading routes, calendars and tariffs.

services.description: The services your utility provides in this town. The networks are there either way; for a service you do not provide, another utility runs it: no accounts, meters, reads, bills, crews, maintenance or calls of yours, and its settings do not apply.
services.title: Services

mru_target_meters.description: Target premises per meter reading unit (route).
mru_target_meters.title: Mru Target Meters

bill_cycles.description: Billing portions per month (one per working day).
bill_cycles.title: Bill Cycles

tax_rate.description: Sales tax on utility bills (Ontario HST).
tax_rate.title: Tax Rate

electric_fixed_monthly.description: Electric fixed delivery charge per month.
electric_fixed_monthly.title: Electric Fixed Monthly

electric_blocks.description: Electric energy price blocks per kWh (summer threshold).
electric_blocks.title: Electric Blocks

wastewater_ratio.description: Wastewater charge as a multiple of the water volumetric charge.
wastewater_ratio.title: Wastewater Ratio

on_time_payer_share.description: Share of accounts that pay on time.

due_days.description: Days from invoice to due date.
due_days.title: Due Days

rpa_coverage.description: Share of exception types with an RPA/auto-resolve rule.
rpa_coverage.title: Rpa Coverage

analyst_queue_days_min.description: Minimum queue wait before an analyst picks up an exception.
analyst_queue_days_min.title: Analyst Queue Days Min

carry_rate_per_day.description: Carrying cost per account per day before invoicing.
carry_rate_per_day.title: Carry Rate Per Day

receivable_carry_ratio.description: Receivable carry as a share of the billing carry rate.
receivable_carry_ratio.title: Receivable Carry Ratio

analysts.description: Billing analysts working the exception queues.
analysts.title: Analysts

analyst_hours_per_day.description: Productive queue hours per analyst per business day.
analyst_hours_per_day.title: Analyst Hours Per Day

supervisor_hours_per_day.description: Supervisor hours on escalations per business day.
supervisor_hours_per_day.title: Supervisor Hours Per Day

supervisor_queue_days_min.description: Minimum wait before a supervisor picks up an escalation (VEE's own escalations wait this long).
supervisor_queue_days_min.title: Supervisor Queue Days Min

supervisor_queue_days_max.description: Maximum wait before a supervisor picks up an escalation from an analyst or you. An escalation you take yourself (assign) waits for you.
supervisor_queue_days_max.title: Supervisor Queue Days Max

field_orders_per_day.description: Meter investigations, re-reads and exchanges completed per business day.

field_days_min.description: Earliest a field order is worked after it is raised.

analyst_accuracy.description: Share of reviews where the analyst finds the true cause.
analyst_accuracy.title: Analyst Accuracy

misread.description: Reads off by one in a high digit.

consecutive_estimates.description: Runs of 2–4 estimated periods (higher on manual routes).
consecutive_estimates.title: Consecutive Estimates

exchange_registration_failure.description: Meter exchanges whose new serial fails registration.
exchange_registration_failure.title: Exchange Registration Failure

amr_factor.description: Multiplier on every anomaly rate for AMR (drive-by) meters: an ageing ERT fleet misreads and under-registers more.
amr_factor.title: Amr Factor

manual_factor.description: Multiplier on every anomaly rate for manually read meters.
manual_factor.title: Manual Factor

leak_m3h.description: Leak rate added to the target premise's water demand.
leak_m3h.title: Leak M3H

ami_missed_read.title: Ami Missed Read

amr_missed_read.description: Drive-by reads missed (no signal, street skipped; 1: the van does not go out).
amr_missed_read.title: Amr Missed Read

manual_no_access.description: Manual reads with no access (locked gate, dog, meter inside; 1: nobody walks the route).
manual_no_access.title: Manual No Access

no_access_repeat.description: Chance a missed manual read is missed again the next month.
no_access_repeat.title: No Access Repeat

schema.description: Validation, estimation and editing: the five-test battery, confidence and disposition (VEE v5 shape).

high_ratio.description: Flag consumption above this multiple of expected (tolerance high).
high_ratio.title: High Ratio

low_ratio.description: Flag consumption below this share of expected (tolerance low).
low_ratio.title: Low Ratio

zero_at_occupied.description: Flag zero consumption at an occupied premise.
zero_at_occupied.title: Zero At Occupied

max_consecutive_estimates.description: Estimates in a row before a field read is ordered.
max_consecutive_estimates.title: Max Consecutive Estimates

accept_confidence.description: Auto-accept at or above this confidence.
accept_confidence.title: Accept Confidence

escalate_impact.description: Escalate a doubtful read when its bill impact exceeds this.
escalate_impact.title: Escalate Impact

trend_ratio.description: Persistent low use: flag reads below this share of expected …
trend_ratio.title: Trend Ratio

trend_periods.description: … for this many periods in a row.
trend_periods.title: Trend Periods

oms_events.description: Use outage events (OMS, AMI last gasps) from operations: hours without service lower the expected use.
oms_events.title: Oms Events

estimation.description: Estimation method for missing or rejected reads.
estimation.title: Estimation

history_noise.description: Spread of prior-year history around this year's normal usage.
history_noise.title: History Noise

schema.description: Bill checks, tariff versions, invoicing, payments and dunning.

rate_change_date.description: Date a new tariff version takes effect (volumetric prices).
rate_change_date.title: Rate Change Date

rate_change_pct.description: Volumetric price change in the new tariff version.
rate_change_pct.title: Rate Change Pct

high_bill_ratio.description: Block a bill above this multiple of its expected amount (prior-year use at current prices).
high_bill_ratio.title: High Bill Ratio

high_bill_min.description: …and at least this much above the expected amount.
high_bill_min.title: High Bill Min

first_bill_limit.description: Block a bill with no expected use (vacant, new) above this total.
first_bill_limit.title: First Bill Limit

credit_review.description: Block a bill that is a credit larger than this.
credit_review.title: Credit Review

outsort_auto_release_max.description: RPA may release a high-bill or large-credit outsort only up to this bill amount (either sign); a larger one waits for an analyst.
outsort_auto_release_max.title: Outsort Auto Release Max

billing_queue_worked_by.description: Who works the BILLING queue (high bills, large credits, true-ups, rate-class errors): the simulated analysts and RPA, or only you. With 'you', no analyst or RPA touches a billing block, so every outsort waits in the Studio for your release, rebill or escalation.
billing_queue_worked_by.title: Billing Queue Worked By

trueup_max_ratio.description: Block a bill whose estimate true-up (a negative period quantity) is larger than this multiple of the period's expected use; an analyst decides it.
trueup_max_ratio.title: Trueup Max Ratio

data_error_rate.description: Installations with a wrong rate class in billing master data (per 1,000 per year).
data_error_rate.title: Data Error Rate

print_lag_days.description: Days from invoice creation to issue.
print_lag_days.title: Print Lag Days

pad_reject_rate.description: Pre-authorized debits returned for insufficient funds.
pad_reject_rate.title: Pad Reject Rate

late_fee_pct.description: Late payment charge on overdue amounts (per notice).
late_fee_pct.title: Late Fee Pct

reminder_days.description: Days after the due date for a reminder.
reminder_days.title: Reminder Days

notice_days.description: Days after the due date for an overdue notice and late fee.
notice_days.title: Notice Days

disconnect_days.description: Days after the due date for a disconnection notice.
disconnect_days.title: Disconnect Days

winter_moratorium.description: No disconnection notices for electricity and water from Nov 15 to Apr 30 (Ontario); a notice held for the winter is issued on May 1 if the bill is still unpaid.
winter_moratorium.title: Winter Moratorium

moratorium_start.description: First day of the winter moratorium (MM-DD).
moratorium_start.title: Moratorium Start

moratorium_end.description: Last day of the winter moratorium (MM-DD); held notices go out the day after.
moratorium_end.title: Moratorium End

disconnect_notice_days.description: Days from a disconnection notice to the earliest disconnection. A disconnection also needs a person's approval (the Collections worklist).
disconnect_notice_days.title: Disconnect Notice Days

disconnect_rule_share.description: Share of disconnection notices a collections rule approves when they are issued (the disconnection follows at the earliest day); the rest wait for a person's approval. 0: every disconnection needs you.
disconnect_rule_share.title: Disconnect Rule Share

disconnect_payment_rate.description: Disconnected customers who pay within a week of the disconnection (and are reconnected the next business day); the rest stay off until they pay.
disconnect_payment_rate.title: Disconnect Payment Rate

arrangement_break_rate.description: At-risk payers who break a payment arrangement after a few instalments (dunning resumes); other payers pay every instalment.
arrangement_break_rate.title: Arrangement Break Rate

low_income_referral_rate.description: Disconnection notices and winter moratorium holds after which the call centre refers the customer to a low-income programme (once a year per account).
low_income_referral_rate.title: Low Income Referral Rate

low_income_review_days.description: Business days the low-income agency takes to decide a referral; dunning waits meanwhile.
low_income_review_days.title: Low Income Review Days

low_income_approval_rate.description: Referrals the agency approves with a grant.
low_income_approval_rate.title: Low Income Approval Rate

low_income_grant_max.description: Largest low-income grant credited to an account's arrears.
low_income_grant_max.title: Low Income Grant Max

budget_billing_offer_rate.description: Overdue notices after which the call centre enrols the customer in budget billing (once a year per account); the plan levels later invoices.
budget_billing_offer_rate.title: Budget Billing Offer Rate

per_event.description: Share of triggering events that lead to a contact.
per_event.title: Per Event

per_1000.description: Background contacts per 1,000 accounts per month.
per_1000.title: Per 1000

self_serve.description: Share handled by the IVR or online, with no agent.
self_serve.title: Self Serve

handle_min.description: Agent minutes per contact (talk and wrap-up).
handle_min.title: Handle Min

resolved.description: Share resolved on the first contact.
resolved.title: Resolved

schema.description: Why customers phone, write or use the IVR, and the agents, hours and self-service that answer them. Contacts follow the year: bills, errors, rebills, dunning, payments, move-ins and move-outs, missed reads and the year's outages and gas leaks.

agents.description: Agents on the phones on a business day (a small utility often has one, shared with billing).
agents.title: Agents

patience_s.description: Average time a caller waits before hanging up.
patience_s.title: Patience

retry_share.description: Callers who hung up or found the lines closed and try again.
retry_share.title: Retry Share

repeat_share.description: Callers whose problem was not resolved who contact again within days.
repeat_share.title: Repeat Share

callback.description: Offer a call back instead of holding when the wait is long.
callback.title: Callback

callback_after_s.description: Offer the call back when the expected wait exceeds this.
callback_after_s.title: Call back after

callback_take_share.description: Callers offered a call back who take it.
callback_take_share.title: Callback Take Share

service_target_s.description: Answer target for the service level (answered within it).
service_target_s.title: Service target

self_serve_factor.description: Multiplies every reason's self-service share (0: IVR and web down).
self_serve_factor.title: Self Serve Factor

agent_cost_per_hour.description: Loaded cost of an agent hour on the phones.
agent_cost_per_hour.title: Agent Cost Per Hour

self_serve_cost.description: Cost of a contact the IVR or website handles.
self_serve_cost.title: Self Serve Cost

abandon_cx_cost.description: Customer-experience cost of a caller who hangs up.
abandon_cx_cost.title: Abandon Cx Cost

emergency_answer_s.description: Answer time on the emergency line (gas odour, outages after hours).
emergency_answer_s.title: Emergency answer

high_bill.description: High bill: an invoice at least 1.5 times what the account usually pays (and $40 more).

bill_question.description: Questions about a bill: any invoice, more for estimated bills, first bills and bills after a rate change.

bill_wrong.description: Bill wrong: a bill that overcharges the customer (customers rarely call about undercharges).

back_bill.description: Back bill: a rebill, or the first actual bill after estimates, that catches up on under-billed use.

balance.description: What's my balance: around due dates; mostly the IVR.

payment_arrangement.description: Can't pay: after overdue notices, more after disconnection notices.

payment_problem.description: Payment problem: a pre-authorized debit returned.

password.description: Forgot password or online account help: when bills arrive; most reset online.

move_in.description: Start service: a new account at a premise, days before the move-in.

move_out.description: Stop service: days before an account closes.

new_connection.description: New connection: builders and owners asking for a new service.

outage.description: Outage report: customers who lose power or water (twice as many when it lasts over two hours); the IVR's outage message answers most.

gas_odour.description: I smell gas: neighbours of a gas leak (the household with a service leak calls 9 times in 10); emergency line.

meter_access.description: Meter access: after a no-access read card, and to book field visits.

disconnection.description: Disconnected: customers asking to be reconnected after a disconnection you approved.

complaint.description: Complaint: after a second unresolved contact about the same thing, or after giving up on hold twice.

dispute_cases.description: Share of answered bill-wrong contacts (and unresolved high-bill and back-bill ones) that open a Bill Correction case: an analyst checks the read and rebills, or explains the bill. 0: disputes are only counted.
dispute_cases.title: Dispute Cases

dispute_hold_days.description: Collections pauses dunning on a disputed account until the dispute is decided, at most this long.
dispute_hold_days.title: Dispute Hold Days

complaint_cases.description: A complaint the lines take opens a Customer Complaints case for the analysts to answer (one open complaint per account).
complaint_cases.title: Complaint Cases

frustration_threshold.description: Bad experiences (a hang-up after a long wait, an unresolved contact, a wait past long_wait_s, a complaint) before a customer pays later from then on. 0: never.
frustration_threshold.title: Frustration Threshold

long_wait_s.description: A wait this long counts as a bad experience even when the call is answered.
long_wait_s.title: Long Wait S

autopay_cancel_share.description: Share of frustrated customers on pre-authorized debit who cancel it and pay by hand from then on (later, and sometimes not at all).
autopay_cancel_share.title: Autopay Cancel Share

schema.description: The operations day's background incidents drawn for every day of the year (same storms and leaks the map shows on a date): who loses power or water, for how long, and where gas is smelled. The contact centre hears about them.

enabled.description: Draw outages and leaks across the year.
enabled.title: Enabled

storm_factor.description: Multiplies the chance that a day is a storm day.
storm_factor.title: Storm Factor

incident_factor.description: Multiplies every incident rate (leaks, breaks, failures, faults).
incident_factor.title: Incident Factor

restore_factor.description: Multiplies the time to restore service.
restore_factor.title: Restore Factor

FieldCrew.description: One kind of field crew: how many there are for the town's size, and what an hour costs.

per_1000_premises.description: Crews per 1,000 premises. A fraction is part of a crew's time (the rest goes to work this model does not draw); on-call responders are at least one when above zero.
per_1000_premises.title: Per 1000 Premises

cost_per_hour.description: Loaded cost of a crew hour, truck included.
cost_per_hour.title: Cost Per Hour

overtime_factor.description: Multiplies the hourly cost after hours.
overtime_factor.title: Overtime Factor

FieldCrew.title: FieldCrew

FieldWorkType.description: One kind of field work order: how much of it there is, what it takes and how soon it is due.

rate.description: How much of this work there is (its meaning is in the setting's own description).
rate.title: Rate

minutes.description: Crew minutes on site per order (travel is added for premise visits).
minutes.title: Minutes

target_days.description: Business days from the order's release to its due date (0: the same day; planned work is released on its scheduled day). Emergencies count calendar time: fractions of a day.
target_days.title: Target Days

FieldWorkType.title: FieldWorkType

schema.description: The work the field crews do over the year and the crews that do it: customer emergencies, service orders (disconnects, reconnects, move-ins and move-outs), meter maintenance (seal exchanges, batteries, removals), preventative maintenance on the networks and capital construction (new sets, upgrades, main renewal). Work follows the year: collections, moves, VEE field visits, the contact centre's calls, the year's outages and leaks, the meters' install years and the town's assets. What the crews do changes the year: a disconnected or removed meter is not read or billed, an exchange registers a new meter, and maintenance left overdue fails (dead batteries, drifting meters, outages, gas leaks).

shift_start_hour.description: Crews start their day (local time, business days).
shift_start_hour.title: Shift Start Hour

shift_hours.description: Hours in a crew's working day.
shift_hours.title: Shift Hours

routing.description: Crews drive the town's streets: from the depot in the morning, job to job by the fastest route (the operations driving speeds), and back at the end of the day. Of the jobs equally urgent and due, a crew takes the nearest next. On-call responders drive from the depot and back. Off, or in a town without streets: every visit adds travel_minutes.
routing.title: Routing

stop_minutes.description: With routing: parking, walking to the asset and setting up at each stop, added to the drive.
stop_minutes.title: Stop Minutes

travel_minutes.description: Driving to the job and back, added to every visit without routing (and to the VEE field visits the run times).
travel_minutes.title: Travel Minutes

callout_minutes.description: After hours, the time an on-call responder takes to get on the road.
callout_minutes.title: Callout Minutes

overtime_max_hours.description: Most hours a crew works past its shift to finish same-day and overdue customer work (priority 1 and 2).
overtime_max_hours.title: Overtime Max Hours

remote_switch_share.description: Share of AMI electric meters with a remote connect switch: their disconnects, reconnects and move reads need no truck.
remote_switch_share.title: Remote Switch Share

seal_years_electric.description: Electric meter seal period: a lot whose seal expires this year is sampled.
seal_years_electric.title: Seal Years Electric

seal_sample_size.description: Meters pulled and tested from each lot whose seal expires.
seal_sample_size.title: Seal Sample Size

seal_lot_pass_rate.description: Share of lots that pass compliance sampling and are resealed; a failed lot is exchanged meter by meter before its seal expires.
seal_lot_pass_rate.title: Seal Lot Pass Rate

battery_years.description: Radio module battery life on gas and water meters, AMI and AMR (they have no mains power).
battery_years.title: Battery Years

water_meter_life_years.description: Water meters this old or older are due for replacement.
water_meter_life_years.title: Water Meter Life Years

dead_battery_miss.description: Share of reads a radio module misses once its battery has died (past its life and not replaced): estimates follow.
dead_battery_miss.title: Dead Battery Miss

failed_lot_drift.description: Under-registration of a failed seal lot's meters, from the failed test until each is exchanged.
failed_lot_drift.title: Failed Lot Drift

old_water_meter_drift.description: Under-registration of water meters at or past their service life, until replaced (read at the start of the year).
old_water_meter_drift.title: Old Water Meter Drift

deferred_pole_failures.description: Chance a year that a pole found needing replacement fails once its replacement is overdue (ten times as likely on a storm day): an outage.
deferred_pole_failures.title: Deferred Pole Failures

deferred_tree_faults.description: Chance on a storm day that an overhead span overdue for trimming faults: an outage.
deferred_tree_faults.title: Deferred Tree Faults

deferred_leak_escalation.description: Chance a year that a leak found by survey becomes a public gas leak (odour calls, an emergency) once its repair is overdue.
deferred_leak_escalation.title: Deferred Leak Escalation

renewed_main_break_factor.description: A renewed main's breaks and leaks, as a share of the cast-iron main's it replaced: from the day the construction crew finishes a segment.
renewed_main_break_factor.title: Renewed Main Break Factor

construction_start_month.description: First month of the construction season (digging is frost-free).
construction_start_month.title: Construction Start Month

construction_end_month.description: Last month of the construction season.
construction_end_month.title: Construction End Month

crew_emergency.description: Gas odour and no-supply calls, any hour of any day.
crew_emergency.title: On-call responders

crew_meter.description: Disconnects, reconnects, move visits, exchanges, batteries, removals, investigations, meter sets.
crew_meter.title: Meter technicians

crew_electric.description: Pole work, tree trimming, outage repairs, service upgrades.
crew_electric.title: Electric line crews

crew_gas.description: Leak surveys, regulator stations, leak repairs.
crew_gas.title: Gas crews

gas_odour.description: Gas odour investigation: share of gas odour reports (a leak's first report, every background report) a responder attends.
gas_odour.title: Gas odour

no_supply.description: No supply at one premise (a service fault, a blown fuse, a curb stop): share of single-premise outage reports that need a truck.

outage_repair.description: Repair of the year's outages and leaks (the incident model times it): share recorded against the utility's crew.
outage_repair.title: Outage and leak repair

disconnect.description: Disconnect for non-payment: share of collections disconnections worked (AMI electric with a switch is done remotely).

reconnect.description: Reconnect after payment: share of reconnections worked, due the next business day.

move_out.description: Move-out final read or lock-off: share of account closings at a premise with a meter that cannot be read remotely.
move_out.title: Move-out read

move_in.description: Move-in turn-on or first read: share of account openings at a premise with a meter that cannot be read remotely.
move_in.title: Move-in read

meter_investigation.description: VEE field visit (the run decides when): share recorded against the meter technicians.

corrective_exchange.description: Faulty meter exchanged on a field visit (the run decides when): share recorded.

seal_exchange.description: Seal-expiry exchange: share of the meters due (the sample of every expiring lot, every meter of a failed lot) exchanged. A failed lot's meters are due by 31 December.

ami_battery.description: Module battery replacement on gas and water meters: share of batteries reaching their life this year.
ami_battery.title: Module battery

water_meter_replacement.description: Water meter replacement by age: share of over-age water meters replaced this year.

removal.description: Meter removal (vacant premise, service abandoned): removals per 1,000 premises a year.
removal.title: Meter removal

ami_conversion.description: AMI conversion: share of AMR and manually read meters converted to AMI this year (capital, priority 4).
ami_conversion.title: AMI conversion

pole_inspection.description: Pole inspection: share of poles inspected a year (0.1 is a ten-year cycle).

pole_replacement.description: Pole replacement: share of inspected poles found needing replacement.

tree_trimming.description: Tree trimming: share of overhead spans trimmed a year (minutes per span).

valve_exercise.description: Valve exercising: share of water and gas valves a year.

valve_repair.description: Valve repair: share of exercised valves found broken or stuck.

hydrant_flush.description: Hydrant flushing and inspection: share of hydrants a year (May to October).
hydrant_flush.title: Hydrant flushing

hydrant_repair.description: Hydrant repair: share of flushed hydrants found defective.

leak_survey.description: Gas leak survey: share of gas main length walked a year (minutes per km).

gas_leak_repair.description: Gas leak repair (grade 2): leaks found per surveyed km.

regulator_inspection.description: Regulator station inspection: share of stations (city gate, district regulators) a year.

new_set.description: New service: share of new-connection requests (the contact centre's new connection contacts) that go ahead; built in the construction season.
new_set.title: New set (new service)

meter_set.description: Meter set on a finished new service: share set by a meter technician (the rest come with the contractor).

service_upgrade.description: Electric service upgrade: share of homes with an EV or electric heat upgrading a year.

main_replacement.description: Main renewal: share of cast-iron water and gas main length replaced a year (minutes and materials per 100 m).

schema.description: The windows the KPIs count with: what makes an invoice on time, a read prompt, a case resolved in time, an invoice paid on time. They change the figures reported, never the run itself.

on_time_bill_days.description: Operational invoice issue target: each due service must reach an issued invoice within this many whole calendar days of its scheduled read. Includes print lag; the saved setting key is retained for compatibility.
on_time_bill_days.title: Invoice issue target

timely_invoice_days.title: Timely Invoice Days

read_release_days.description: A held read is released promptly when its case releases it to billing within this many calendar days of the scheduled read.
read_release_days.title: Read Release Days

payment_grace_days.description: An invoice is paid on time when it is settled within this many calendar days after its due date.
payment_grace_days.title: Payment Grace Days

case_resolution_days.description: A case is resolved in time when it closes within this many business days of being raised.
case_resolution_days.title: Case Resolution Days

schema.title: KPI definitions

physicalModules.description:
Dated physical occupancy, deliberately separate from commercial move-in/out.

Opt-in additive tables; old worlds are unchanged until the first accepted command.
All scheduling, application and cancellation share the world's transaction boundary.
Explicit dated weather/risk scenarios, consumed by the existing daily owner.
Opt-in, explainable infrastructure age and cold-weather failure modifiers.
Durable downstream water leaks; physical repair is not an enterprise report.

Durable, opt-in water-main breaks. Administrator physical truth only.

Saved valves bound isolation; configured source connectivity determines supply.
Loss is a configured scenario rate, not a hydraulic pressure calculation.

Opt-in physical supply interruptions on the saved electricity and gas graphs.

Connectivity is an illustrative supply model, not a power-flow or gas-pressure solver.
Only administrator views expose fault truth. Meter exports remain observations.

Sanitary lateral truth: water-derived inflow, blockages, storage and overflow.

This opt-in model has no sewer meters and never changes observation-derived bills.

Customer experience, awareness and contact intent, separate from agent handling.

Only experienced supply loss / visible overflow can trigger this first version.
An internal fault, missing meter transmission or unreceived bill is not awareness.

Simulated customer cash and intentions; never enterprise billing or posting.

Inbound delivery/receipt functions are trusted adapter boundaries, not public
administrator commands. Adapters must authenticate their producer and recipient.
Administrator-configured recurring cashflows within the existing finance owner.
Customer-owned financial contact intentions from actually delivered notices.

Opt-in construction on saved vacant premises; no invented geography or services.

Call apply_due BEFORE occupancy.apply_due inside the existing daily transaction.
The notification boundary deliberately excludes occupancy counts and private causes.

Bounded local clock ownership: field visits, then one committed physical day.

No network delivery or enterprise work is performed. The shared runtime remains
the only clock owner for worlds configured for managed observation delivery.

World-owned observation outbox. Acceptance is distinct from business processing.

The scheduler owns actor authentication and recipient deduplication. Only committed,
observation-only messages leave this store; no recipient database is opened here.

Versioned observation-only export with explicit derived sewer service.

Sewer is calculated from observed water use. No sewer meter is fabricated and
hidden actual consumption is never used to fill missing observations.

Assignment-bound field visits, physical repairs, and independent report delivery.

This local simulator has no enterprise queue access or network transport. Only
an administrator can register crews and accept assignments; a crew can execute
its persisted assignment. Public reports contain on-site findings, never fault
model state or consumption truth. Receipt acceptance is transport acknowledgement,
not an enterprise decision to accept evidence or close an order.

Independent simulator reporting claims; physical visits remain truthful.

Actor IDs are local simulator principals. A transport must authenticate callers
and must not grant workers this owner's physical world reference or admin view.
Read-only saved-road quotes; no reservation, scheduling or physical effects.
Immutable phase dependencies in the existing field owner, not a work queue.
Explicit cancellation and replacement of pending local main-phase work.

Opt-in field broker for an authenticated external Run, not a scheduler.

The composition root supplies trusted, live authority and calendar callbacks.
Neither callback may be populated from an HTTP request or worker payload. See
WORLD_FIELD_MANAGED.md for the deliberately small integration contract.
